method.restrictions: Visible UI, screenshots, visible driver help and in-game facility map only; no source, hidden state, tests, prior reviews or solution guidance.
limits: Software WebGL fallback; no hardware performance conclusion.
Discrete paused driver inputs differ from continuous human mouse and keyboard play.
No audio assessment or claims about human enjoyment.
Extraction not reached; late mission behavior beyond the observed Custodian phase unassessed.

gameplay.reason: Functional optic shots, ammo/reload, supplies on memory recovery and a changing objective give useful decisions. My second attempt recovered all memories and disabled two coils, but incoming damage and multiple small contacts overwhelmed me while orienting; phase timing was difficult with this input method.

presentation.reason: Coherent teal/amber industrial storm atmosphere, reflective ground, clear title art, archive set dressing and a strong relay landmark. Repeated simple robot forms, blocky weapon and sparse yard geometry limit fidelity.

usability.reason: Visible controls, paused facility map, distance markers and move-closer floor-ring prompt made objectives learnable. I repeatedly caught on cover or pillars while trying to reach markers and had to correct approach. Recovery requires fairly precise proximity.

readability.reason: Health/ammo/objective and coil percentages were clear. Cyan markers and amber charging indicators convey intent. Small robot targets, dark cover silhouettes and overlapping directional/enemy cues made combat prioritization harder.

aaaReadiness.reason: A coherent playable mission foundation, but the observed visual detail, enemy variety, combat legibility and navigation clarity fall short of a polished large-budget release. Two attempts cannot establish robustness or broader content depth.

outcomes.notes: Recovered Mara Solberg. Lost health while negotiating west archive exit and moving toward Heart; died before second recovery.
Recovered Elian Vale, Sera Nord and Mara Solberg. Reached Custodian; visible coil HUD showed coil 1 at 100%, coils 2 and 3 OFF before death. Mission not completed.

observedStrengths: Memory recovery restores supplies and clearly advances objective.
Paused facility map supports planning without active damage.
Opening guard optic strategy worked in both attempts.
Custodian shutter window and per-coil feedback made damage progress visible.
observedProblems: Straight-line objective approach often ran into cover or wall edges; alternate entrance messaging helped but required correction.
Small enemy optics and several offscreen threat markers complicated aiming and prioritization.
Station title screen labels build 45 despite review run named build47.
errors: No pageErrors reported in driver responses. All actions, deaths and captures retained.
